description:
Unit: U4
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u4-reorganize-authoring-property-and-fixture-lanes

Outcome
Authoring, property, and corpus files use final namespace owners and declare distinct supplemental proof claims.

Requirements and decisions
R1-R8, R10-R14, R16; KTD1-KTD5, KTD7-KTD9.

Affected surfaces
test/authoring/**; test/property/**; test/test_helper.exs; mix.exs; test/quality/component_proof.yml; test/quality/quality_contract.yml; test/quality/source_manifest.yml; and lane READMEs.

Implementation direction
Move Agent and Flow authoring to test/authoring/{jido_agent,jido_flow}. Move property families to test/property/{jido_agent_server,jido_expr,jido_signal} and Signal corpus to test/property/corpus/jido_signal. Rename modules, update loaders and report selection, and record the distinct authoring and property claims as supplemental proof. Update only source-manifest target_path values. Preserve source_path history.

Acceptance
Agent and Flow authoring run together and stay out of default. Property and fuzz aliases select all three families. Focused files use only their family policy. Signal corpus replay passes. Every authoring and property evidence group names a claim distinct from canonical behavior. Manifest targets exist and are unique.

Verification
mix test.authoring --warnings-as-errors
mix test.property --warnings-as-errors
mix test.fuzz --warnings-as-errors
mix test test/quality/source_manifest_test.exs test/quality/component_proof_test.exs --seed 0
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
Authoring and property proof pass from final paths, supplemental claims are registered, and U5 can start.
